points.description: Setup: labels the data as positive/negative classes and initializes the weights (e.g. randomly or to zero).
points.partial_credit: Only one of labelling or initializing weights mentioned.

points.description: Loop with update rule: repeatedly goes over the data points (epochs) and, for a misclassified point (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for the correct class), updates the weights by adding eta times x (w += eta*x, or sign/label-adjusted equivalent).
points.partial_credit: Has a loop and an update on errors but the rule is vague or incomplete.

points.description: Stopping: repeats until weights no longer change (or no misclassifications), and may note convergence because the data is linearly separable.
points.partial_credit: Vague stopping idea such as a fixed number of epochs.

rubric.notes: Full marks for pseudo-code (any wording) that initializes weights, loops over the data updating weights on misclassified points with a learning-rate times x rule, and stops when weights stop changing. Give part marks for a right-track but vague or incomplete algorithm, such as an update step without the misclassification condition. Give no marks for answers that are off-topic or describe something other than the perceptron learning rule. Exact syntax and the convergence remark are not required.
